winks.rationale: The word 'Sapphire' is the exact name of a community in Jackson County, North Carolina.
'Lion's' reads directly as Lions, a place name (e.g., Lions, several US localities; Lions Head features).
The leading word 'Star' is the exact name of a town in Montgomery County, North Carolina (also Star, ID).
Reading past the show, 'Star' is the exact name of a town in Montgomery County, NC.
The surname 'Scott' reads as the place root Scott/Scotts (e.g., Scotts, NC in Iredell County; Scott County).
The name 'Logan' is the exact name of a city in Utah and of Logan County in several states.
'Redwood' is a common US place root (Redwood Falls, MN; Redwood County; Redwood National Park).
'Mountain View' is a generic descriptive place name shared by many US towns.
Muller literally means 'miller'; Miller is a common US place name (Miller, SD), but the link is faint.
'Beech' is a common US place root (Beech Mountain, NC; Beech Grove, IN).
'Blackwater' is a US place name (Blackwater River, FL/VA; Blackwater, MO).
